reviews.title: Security Architecture
reviews.body:
# Security Architecture

## Purpose

Defines the complete cybersecurity architecture of the Medical Passport platform.

---

# Security Principles

• Zero Trust

• Least Privilege

• Defense in Depth

• Secure by Design

• Privacy by Design

---

# Authentication

• JWT

• Refresh Tokens

• OAuth2

• OpenID Connect

• Passkeys (Future)

• Face ID

• Touch ID

---

# Authorization

• RBAC

• ABAC (Future)

• Role Validation

• Permission Policies

• Session Validation

---

# Encryption

Data at Rest

• AES-256

Data in Transit

• TLS 1.3

Passwords

• Argon2id

File Encryption

• AES-256

Database Encryption

• Transparent Data Encryption

---

# API Protection

• Rate Limiting

• API Gateway

• WAF

• IP Filtering

• Request Validation

• Response Validation

---

# Mobile Security

• Certificate Pinning

• Jailbreak Detection

• Root Detection

• Secure Storage

• Anti-Tampering

• Debug Protection

---

# Server Security

• Reverse Proxy

• Firewall

• IDS

• IPS

• Container Isolation

• Secrets Management

---

# Monitoring

• Audit Logs

• SIEM

• Threat Detection

• Intrusion Detection

• Security Alerts

• Incident Tracking

---

# Compliance

• GDPR

• HIPAA

• ISO 27001

• ISO 27799

• eIDAS

• OWASP ASVS

• OWASP Mobile Top 10

---

# Integrations

├── Authentication

├── API Gateway

├── Database

├── AI

├── QR Passport

├── Telemedicine

├── Administration

├── Audit Logs

---

Future Features

• Hardware Security Module (HSM)

• Confidential Computing

• AI Threat Detection

• Behavioral Authentication

• Continuous Risk Assessment

• Quantum-resistant Cryptography

---

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Security architecture, per-request zero-trust enforcement and monitoring form one existing shared security owner. Identity supplies authenticated subject/session; Consent supplies policy/grant and legal-authority evidence; Security enforces action/resource/context and Audit records outcomes. Authentication alone never authorizes patient data. Legacy ABAC marked future cannot defer patient/purpose/recipient checks required by the current MVP. Preserve mobile/server/API/encryption/monitoring and future HSM/confidential/quantum-resistant intentions without claiming certification or implementation.

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Professional and facility directories share the existing account/practitioner/organization owner; they do not create a new clinical truth store or an owner per specialty. Preserve qualifications, expertise, biography/publications, languages, international certification and network affiliations; verify source, issuing authority, scope, expiry and status. Retain center-specific dialysis, endoscopy, transfusion, infusion, isolation/ICU, laser, rehabilitation, surgery, diagnostic, maternity/delivery and working-hour/contact capabilities. A directory claim is not current staffing, treatment privilege or patient-data authorization. Fertility success rates require denominator/time/cohort provenance and must not be treated as a personal outcome estimate.
